column1: # Every page path REDSTONEPEDIA ever published (crates/site/src/published.rs). `site build` writes
# a redirect page at each one it does not build (to the current page of the same kind), `site
# deploy` adds what it publishes, `site smoke` checks each one resolves. Append-only: git merges
# it by union (.gitattributes). Columns: path, what (circuit, clock, door, family, page, deleted:
# a page vjeux deleted), key (a circuit's study/kind, a clock's period in gt, a door's board, a
# family's card), row (a parametric circuit's size), title (what it was), first (first published).
